metadata.description: German multidimensional questionnaire for chronic stress and stress-related demands.
metadata.intended_use: Research, occupational health, psychosomatic care, and assessment of chronic stress exposure.
metadata.name_origin: Trierer Inventar zum chronischen Stress, abbreviated TICS.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a German instrument family with differentiated chronic-stress scales and short forms.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Chronic stress is represented through persistent demands, worries, overload, and insufficient recognition or support rather than a single acute event.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use the exact TICS form and norms; scale scores describe perceived chronic stress and do not establish burnout or another diagnosis.

versions.source_citation: Schulz, Schlotz, and Becker (2004). Trierer Inventar zum chronischen Stress (TICS).
